integrity: A geometric support-table proof is corroborated, but not replaced, by two independently programmed finite tests; mathematical originality and proof have received self-review only.
limitations: Finite point-line incidence structures of the stated three families only, pure two-sort incidence signature, noncounting FO^3. No assertion about arbitrary linear spaces, named parallelism, counting logic or FO^4; prior-art comparison qualified.
title: Six unrestricted three-variable incidence theories of finite line geometries
